scripts.lint: eslint apps packages scripts eslint.config.mjs vitest.workspace.ts --ext .ts,.tsx,.js,.mjs,.cjs
scripts.lint:fix: eslint apps packages scripts eslint.config.mjs vitest.workspace.ts --ext .ts,.tsx,.js,.mjs,.cjs --fix
scripts.lint:py: cd services/chem-service && poetry run ruff check app.py chem_service tests
scripts.format:check:py: cd services/chem-service && poetry run ruff format --check app.py chem_service tests

scripts.test: turbo run test && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm run test:py
